title: Natural structure-object evaluation with exponent-one normalization
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number and f:Fin(r) to A. Let X=Spec(A), U be the principal-open union, O the extended tilde of A[0], and I_e and u_e the tails and augmentations of [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Assume the derived categories on X, every over-open, U and A-modules in the universes of the Lean statement [def-pc-derived-category]. Let R be derived restriction followed by the over-equivalence, H=H^0 on D(A), and G=derived affineOpenSections(U). Define c_e in H(G(I_e)) to be the identity-chain stage class of [lem-sc-koszul-open-hom-chain-representatives], followed by H(Q(iota_e)) and H(koszulCechDerivedComparison(I_e)) of [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. There exist equivalences b_E:Hom(R(O),R(E)) to H(G(E)), natural in every derived arrow E to E', with the single normalization b_O(id)=H(G(u_0))(c_0). No evaluation of an inverse augmentation at a tail object and no formula at other indices is asserted.

source.place: Structure-sheaf specialization of the first paragraph; Tags 08DC and 08D1, exponent-one augmented identity cycle

proof.text: Specialize derivedOpenStructure_evaluation_unit at U=koszulOpen(A,r,f), obtaining b, its postcomposition identity and b_O(id)=derivedOpenStructureUnit(A,U).

Apply koszulOpen_exponent_one_unit and reverse its equality. Transitivity with the preceding normalization gives b_O(id)=H(G(u_0))(c_0), with exactly the original c expression. Return the same equivalences and naturality. The Lean proof is obtain, refine, and equality transitivity; the signature is unchanged.

The exponent-one normalization is proved from ordinary Cech homology and existing chain-class naturality. No arbitrary existential data is used in a definition.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulOpen_structure_evaluation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
          ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    let G := (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor
    let c := fun e : ℕ ↦ H.map (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e))
        (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι
          (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
            (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e))) e))
          (koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e) e (𝟙 _)))
    ∃ b : ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)),
      (R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E) ≃ H.obj (G.obj E),
      (∀ (E E' : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A))) (g : E ⟶ E')
        (ψ : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E),
        b E' (ψ ≫ R.map g) = H.map (G.map g) (b E ψ)) ∧
      b (koszulOpenStructure A) (𝟙 _) =
        H.map (G.map (koszulOpenUnit A r f 0)) (c 0)
